items.title: 16.1 General instructions to the students (students ke liye aam hidayat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 16.1, printed page 337.

blocks.text: Chemistry laboratory ek chemist ki workshop hai. Yeh woh jagah hai jahan student ko fixed procedures (tareeqon) par chal kar substances ki physical aur chemical characteristics (khoobiyan) observe karna (dekhna) sikhaya jata hai. Lab ka kaam shuru karne se pehle student ko lab ka layout (naqsha) aur lab ki mez aur side shelves par lagi fittings achhi tarah pehchan leni chahiye.

items: Students lab mein har waqt responsibility (zimmedari) se kaam karein.
Lab mein akele kaam na karein. Experiments lab instructor aur doosre lab staff ki presence (maujoodgi) mein kiye jayein.
Lab mein kaam karte waqt hamesha lab coat aur safety goggles pehnein. Larkiyan kaam shuru karne se pehle apna scarf aur baal bandh lein.
Kaam shuru karne se pehle kisi bhi equipment ya experiment ke potential hazards (mumkina khatre) maloom karein. Zaroori safety precautions (hifazat ke liye ehtiyat) har haal mein karein.
Lab mein bheer na ho; har student apni jagah par rahe aur doosron se safe distance par kaam kare.
Lab mein khane ki koi cheez na layein. Kisi compound ya gas ko kabhi chakhein ya soonghein nahi.
Koi accident (hadsa) ho ya sheeshe ka saman (glassware) toot jaye to foran lab incharge ko batayein.
Agar aap koi instrument ya equipment theek se istemal nahi kar sakte to instructor se madad lein.
Chemicals nali (drain) mein na bahayein aur chemical waste (bekaar chemicals) phenkne ke liye sewer istemal na karein.
Lab mein lage warning signs par amal karein.

blocks.prompt: Ek student instructor ke chale jane ke baad akele naya apparatus azmana chahta hai. Kaun si instructions yahan laagu hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Do instructions: (ii) lab mein akele kaam na karein, experiments instructor aur lab staff ki presence mein hon; aur (viii) jo instrument theek se istemal karna na aata ho us ke liye instructor se madad lein.

items: Zimmedari se kaam; akele kaam nahi; lab coat, goggles, baal aur scarf bandhe hue.
Pehle khatre pehchanein; bheer nahi; khana nahi, chakhna ya soonghna nahi.
Accident ya tootna foran report karein; madad lein; nali ya sewer mein chemicals nahi; warning signs par amal.
